page_title: CRY 1-3 CHE | Crystal Palace v Chelsea 12/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Chelsea work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+7' Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
90+7' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) inside the box.
90+4' Having seen unsporting behavior, Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is the recipient.
90+4' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Cole Palmer tees up Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Dean Henderson.
90+2' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) gets a yellow card.
90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Cole Palmer pulls the ball back for Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Dean Henderson, who pulls off a comfortable save!
88' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and signals a foul after Axel Disasi (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
86' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
85' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
84' Roy Hodgson has decided to make a change. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) replaces Matheus Franca.
84' Substitution. Malo Gusto makes his way off the pitch and Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
83' Wow, what an escape. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
81' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
80' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
79' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) replacing Nicolas Jackson.
79' Will Hughes goes off the pitch and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on.
78' A great solo run by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Dean Henderson.
77' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Djordje Petrovic.
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Dean Henderson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
74' The resulting corner, taken by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), comes to nothing.

73' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
73' PENALTY APPEAL by Chelsea, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
70' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is booked for saying more than Michael Oliver was willing to tolerate.

70' He should have done better. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is afforded space to connect with a Conor Gallagher cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
67' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
66' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
66' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Now Chelsea have a corner.
66' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
65' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a chip pass into the box, but Djordje Petrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.

62' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
62' It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
61' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) is substituted due to injury. Mauricio Pochettino gives a chance to Levi Colwill.
60' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
59' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Cole Palmer (Chelsea), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
57' The foul by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
57' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
56' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jefferson Lerma.
55' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) heads on.
53' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' Malo Gusto links up with Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
50' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Conor Gallagher (Chelsea). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

50' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.

47' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Malo Gusto. The score is now 1:1.
46' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) comes on the pitch for Noni Madueke.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

45+1' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
42' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' One of the Crystal Palace players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
40' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
36' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is able to continue to play.
34' The game is interrupted now, Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

34' Good touch by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
33' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

30' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Djordje Petrovic just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
27' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) tries to find Noni Madueke, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
27' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
25' Chelsea are ruled offside.
23' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Djordje Petrovic easily deals with the threat.
23' The ball is cleared after Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 19:81.
20' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
19' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Chelsea will take a corner kick.
18' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) tries to find Jean-Philippe Mateta, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
16' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
15' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

13' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.

12' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
11' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
10' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
9' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
7' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) sends a long cross over to Nicolas Jackson, but Dean Henderson comes forward to gather the ball.

6' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
5' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Malo Gusto (Chelsea) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
3' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
